question.prompt: \(A\) and \(B\) lie on the same side of line \(l\), \(A'\) is the reflection of \(A\) across \(l\), and \(A'B=9\). Point \(P\) moves along \(l\). What is the minimum value of \(PA+PB\)?

solutions.explanation: \(PA=PA'\), so \(PA+PB=PA'+PB\geq A'B\). Equality holds when \(P\) is at the intersection of segment \(A'B\) and \(l\), giving a minimum value of \(9\).
solutions.title: Reflection bound and equality
